LanguageData.CC_PEv4_ExamFailed: {FELLOW} examined {PAWN_nameDef} in front of the colony, and {PAWN_pronoun} did not pass. The society will not examine {PAWN_objective} again for a while.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_ExamFailedQuiet: {FELLOW} examined {PAWN_nameDef} in private, and {PAWN_pronoun} did not pass. Nobody else heard it, and the society will not examine {PAWN_objective} again for a while.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_ExamPassed: {PAWN_nameDef} passed the examination, and {FACTION} have named {PAWN_objective} a corresponding fellow. The society will send {PAWN_objective} a book each season.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_ExamPassedExpert: {PAWN_nameDef} passed the examination, and {FACTION} have named {PAWN_objective} a corresponding fellow. The society will send {PAWN_objective} a book each season, and {PAWN_pronoun} now has the Researcher expertise.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_FellowChronicle: {FACTION} examined {PAWN_nameDef} and named {PAWN_objective} one of their corresponding fellows.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_FellowBook: {FACTION} sent {PAWN_nameDef} a book for the season, as they do for their corresponding fellows: {BOOK}. It is by the gate.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_FellowBookComing: One of {FACTION} is on the way with this season's book for {PAWN_nameDef}, their corresponding fellow.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_ExamineeGone: The one the society wants to examine is not here.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_NoGathering: Gatherings are not played out on the map with the current settings.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Impact_ExamQuiet: {1} sits with {0} and examines {0} in private, with a bar while they talk.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Impact_Fellow: {0} is named a corresponding fellow: a lasting good memory, the society's word on {0}, and a book each season.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Impact_FellowExpert: {0} is named a corresponding fellow: a lasting good memory, the society's word on {0}, a book each season and the Researcher expertise.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Impact_Fail: {0} fails the examination in front of the colony, and is stung by it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Impact_FailQuiet: {0} fails the examination, but nobody else hears it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_SchoolDispute: {X_nameDef} and {THING} of the summer school have started arguing at their table about what an old text really says, and the afternoon's lessons have stopped. The colony could send someone to end it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_SchoolSettled: {A_nameDef} talked {X_nameDef} and the other fellow out of their argument, and the school's lessons can go on.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_SchoolSulk: The fellows' argument ended with nobody speaking to anyone. There will be no more lessons today, and the camp is uneasy.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_SchoolSulkTried: {A_nameDef} tried to end the fellows' argument, but it only made them more stubborn. There will be no more lessons today, and the camp is uneasy.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_SchoolBooksBack: The summer school set down the colony's books by its camp as it left: {COUNT} of them.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_SchoolBest: {X_nameDef} left a book by the camp for {A_nameDef}, the summer school's best student with {COUNT} lessons: {THING}. The society will remember {A_objective}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_NoLessonToday: The fellows are not teaching this afternoon.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_LessonAfternoon: Lessons are held in the afternoon, from {0}h to {1}h.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_LessonsDone: The school has given its {0} lessons for today.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_BooksLent: The colony's books are already on the school's table.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_NoBooks: The colony has no books in its stores to lend.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Impact_School: {0}'s summer school camps on the colony's land for a week and teaches every afternoon: {1} lessons a day at most, asked for from its page.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Impact_Lend: Up to {0} of the colony's books go to the school's table, and every lesson teaches {1}% more. They are set down for the colony when the school leaves.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Impact_Settle: {0} walks over to the fellows' table and tries to end their argument: about {1}% likely to work, by {0}'s skill with people. Otherwise it ends in a sulk.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_ContractKept: The contract with {FACTION} was delivered in full, and they paid {COUNT} silver. Their next contract will be bigger.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_ContractShort: The contract with {FACTION} was delivered short. They paid {COUNT} silver for what came, less the fee of {FEE}, and their terms will be less favourable for a while.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_ContractDefault: The contract with {FACTION} was not delivered. The fee of {FEE} silver went to them, and their terms will be less favourable for a while.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_ContractDebt: The contract with {FACTION} was not delivered, and the fee of {FEE} silver is now among the colony's debts to them. Their terms will be less favourable for a while.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_ContractNone: The stores hold none of the goods.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_ContractAllThere: All the goods are in the stores.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Impact_Contract: A contract for {0}, due by {1}, for {2} silver when it is delivered.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Impact_ContractDefault: Short or not delivered on the day: a fee of {0} silver and less favourable terms for a while.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Impact_Bigger: The enclave's next contract will be bigger.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Impact_Default: A default: a fee of {0} silver, and less favourable terms for {1} days. The next contract goes back to its first size.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_LanderDown: {FACTION}'s lander came down by the crash. Its marshals are taking their broker and the cargo aboard.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_PodTaken: {FACTION}'s marshals found {COUNT} of their crates gone from the crash. They will remember who took them.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_PodPaid: {FACTION} paid {COUNT} silver, a fifth of the cargo, for the care of {BROKER}, as they promised.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Impact_Rescue: {0} goes to the crash and carries {1} to a bed, where the colony's doctors see to the broker. Without a free bed, {0} tends the broker at the crash.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Impact_Share: When their lander comes, the enclave pays {0} silver, a fifth of the cargo.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Impact_Rob: The colony takes the cargo: {0}, about {1} silver's worth.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Impact_Grudge: {0} will hold it against the colony for a long time.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Impact_Left: {0}'s lander comes in the morning for the broker and the cargo. Nothing is owed either way.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Foul_corpse: a body rotting in the water
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Foul_pollution: poisoned ground running into the water
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_WaterClean: The colony's water is clean again, and {FACTION}'s boats will come again.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_WaterCleaned: {PAWN} and the river warden of {FACTION} cleaned the fouled water. The river folk are grateful, and their boats will keep coming.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_WaterCleanedAlone: The river warden of {FACTION} cleaned the fouled water alone and went home.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_WaterAlreadyClean: Nothing fouls the water there now.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_HelperGone: The colonist who would help is not here.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Impact_Clean: {1} and {0} go from spot to spot along the water until all {2} are clean: bodies pulled out onto dry ground for the colony to bury, wastepacks carried away from the water, poisoned bank cleared.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Impact_CleanAlone: {0} goes from spot to spot along the water alone until all {2} are clean, which takes longer.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Impact_Fouled: {0} will remember that the colony fouled the water and left it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Impact_CatchStop: The river folk's boat-trader and their nets stop coming until the water is clean again.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_LanternsAtCrossing: {FACTION}'s boatmen resting at the crossing are setting lanterns on the water for their knot night.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Impact_Floating: The boatmen set {0} floating lanterns on the colony's water, and they stay there afterwards as the colony's.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Impact_Torches: The boatmen set {0} torches along the colony's bank for the night and take them home in the morning.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_FloodName: a camp on the bank after the flood
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_FloodGuests: {COUNT} of the flooded families' old people and children are now staying with the colony as its guests.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_FloodSick: {A_nameDef} has caught {THING} from the families camped on the bank.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_CatchIn: Their catch is enough to feed them now.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_NeedsHospitality: Needs Hospitality, with invited visitors as its guests.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_GuestsTaken: Their old and young are already the colony's guests.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Impact_Flood: The families of {0} camp on the colony's bank until the river goes down, five to ten days. They fish, ask for food for their first days, and may mend what is worn.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Impact_FloodGuests: Up to {0} of their old people and children stay with the colony as Hospitality's guests, in its guest beds.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Impact_FloodSick: The families may bring a sickness from the flood water to the colony, rarely.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Impact_Knot: When they leave on good terms, {0} tie a knot in the net for the colony: +{1} goodwill.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Hull_1: {X_nameDef} and the other boatwrights have laid the keel on blocks on the bank, with its posts pegged on.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Hull_2: The boatwrights have bent the ribs onto the keel, and the first planks are going on along the bottom.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Hull_3: The boatwrights have planked and pitched the hull. It is ready to be launched.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_HullStorm: The rain has raised the water over the boat-builders' slip, and they have lost a day's work on the hull. They will stay a day longer.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_HullFloated: The boat-builders launched the finished hull and floated it home down the river.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_DinghySold: {X_nameDef} and the boatwrights fitted the finished hull out as a dinghy and set it on the water for the colony.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_NoVehicles: Needs Vehicle Framework and Vanilla Vehicles Expanded.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_DinghyBought: The colony has bought the dinghy already.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_HullUnfinished: The hull is not finished yet.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_NoHullYet: The hull has not been started yet.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Impact_Boat: {0}'s boatwrights camp by the colony's water for a week and build a hull on the bank, a stage every couple of days.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Impact_BoatBrief: A boat built on the bank
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Impact_Trees: They fell some of the colony's wild trees for it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Impact_DinghyOffer: When it is finished, the colony can buy it as a dinghy for wood and silver.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Page_legend: a beast of legend in the region
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Page_nemesis: a beast that had killed people
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_PagePassion: The kill gave {PAWN_objective} a passion for {SKILL}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_PageTied: A keeper of {FACTION}'s book wrote {PAWN_nameDef}'s kill of {BEAST} into the Wardens' book and tied a red cord on {PAWN_possessive} sleeve at the gate.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_PageChronicle: {FACTION} wrote {PAWN_nameDef}'s kill of {BEAST} into their book and tied a red cord on {PAWN_possessive} sleeve.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_NoPelt: The colony has none of the pelt in its stores.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Impact_Cord: {0} meets {1} at the gate, who writes the page and ties a red cord on {0}'s sleeve, with a bar while it is done.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Impact_PageExpert: {0} gets a lasting good memory, the Wardens' word on {0}, and the Hunter expertise.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Impact_PagePassion: {0} gets a lasting good memory, the Wardens' word on {0}, and a passion in the skill that made the kill.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_ManhuntDone: {FACTION}'s Wardens have finished with the beasts and are walking home.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Impact_Split: As on their hunts: the Wardens skin what they brought down and keep the hides, and the meat is left for the colony.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Impact_SplitBrief: Hides for them, meat for the colony
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Impact_Keep: The Wardens take everything they bring down.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Impact_Away: {0}'s Wardens break off and walk home.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_HiveIn: {FACTION}'s Wardens are going into the hive with fire.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_HiveDone: The hive near the colony is burned out, and {FACTION}'s Wardens are walking home.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_HivesGone: There is no hive left to burn.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Impact_HiveTogether: {0} Wardens wait at the edge for the colony's drafted fighters to come within reach of the {1}, for {2} hours at most, and then go in with fire.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Impact_HiveAlone: {0} Wardens go into the {1} with fire now.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Impact_HiveWatch: {0} Wardens keep watch at the edge for {3} hours in case the insects come out, and then go home.
LanguageData.CC_PEv4_Impact_HiveFight: The insects will fight to defend the hive, and fire can spread.
